summary: Russell's Mercedes charges into Zandvoort hunting pole position as McLaren's Norris pursues the championship lead, with Leclerc's Ferrari waiting to capitalize on any misstep through the high-speed corners. Antonelli's surprising pace in opening practice signals a three-team battle emerging, while Red Bull faces the sprint without Hadjar following his wrist injury, handing rivals an opportunity to chip away at the points. A strong showing this weekend could prove decisive in the title race before F1 says goodbye to Zandvoort's daunting seaside layout for good.
